itions as well as cultural and sports activities like Coffee with SIBM, Arcturus, Imperio, National Alumni Meet, Transcend, The Blueprint, Entrepreneurship Summit, Sports Conclave,PRoelio and many more. SIBM Pune ensures

ine ‘Scripting aspirations since 1978’ holds true as SIBM has produced numerous industry stalwarts and entrepreneurs, who have left a mark in the minds and hearts of the people they connect with. SIBM also instills a dee
